job.title: Software Engineer II, Backend
job.pay_full: $165,000 – $225,000 a year base pay in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT; $146,000 – $206,000 a year in all other U.S. states

details.about: Affirm gives people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees. Its engineering team builds the reliable, scalable systems behind the business. New backend engineers are matched with a team after the interview process, with a recruiter helping find the best fit.
duties: With support from your tech lead and manager, break larger projects into tasks and deliver them in phases
Work with product management, design and analytics on ideas, technical constraints, risks and trade-offs
Create and monitor metrics, escalate when needed and support keep-the-lights-on and on-call work
Help build team community, including taking part in interviews
needs: 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer
Experience designing, developing and launching backend systems; proficient in Python or Kotlin
Familiarity with distributed-systems building blocks and technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes
Clear, well-tested, extensible code that ties multiple software components together
Comfort navigating a large codebase, debugging others' code and giving code review feedback
Ownership of your own growth and strong written and verbal communication
Equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field
details.benefits: Base pay $165,000 – $225,000 a year in CA, WA, NY, NJ and CT, or $146,000 – $206,000 a year in all other U.S. states; new hires typically start at the start of the range. Total compensation may include equity, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage plus dental and vision for you and your dependents, flexible time off, holidays and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.
notes: Remote-first: most roles can be done from almost anywhere in the U.S.; new hires are invited to an in-person onboarding
Team is matched after the interview process
Accommodations are available for candidates with disabilities
